title: Functional groups: Classification of organic compounds

assemble.prompt: Match each term to its definition.

items.label: Stereochemical formula
items.clue: A formula that shows the three-dimensional arrangement of atoms.

items.label: Empirical formula
items.clue: The simplest whole-number ratio of the atoms of each element in a compound.

items.label: Skeletal formula
items.clue: A simplified structural formula in which the carbon chain is drawn as a zig-zag of lines.

items.label: General formula
items.clue: A formula in terms of n (the number of carbon atoms) that fits every member of a homologous series.

questions.stem: Propan-2-ol has the molecular formula C₃H₈O. Which statement about the formula C₃H₈O is correct?

options.text: It is the molecular formula only, since an empirical formula is simpler.
It is a condensed structural formula, as it lists every atom present.
It identifies propan-2-ol, since no other compound has this formula.
It is both the molecular and the empirical formula of propan-2-ol.

questions.explanation: The subscripts 3, 8 and 1 have no common factor, so the ratio C:H:O = 3:8:1 is already the simplest whole-number ratio. The empirical formula is therefore identical to the molecular formula.

questions.stem: Which compound contains an ester group?

options.text: CH₃COOH
CH₃CH₂OCH₃
CH₃COOCH₃
CH₃COCH₂CH₃

questions.explanation: In CH₃COOCH₃ (methyl ethanoate) the carbonyl carbon is bonded to an oxygen atom that is bonded to a carbon atom, the –COO– ester group, R–COO–R′.

questions.stem: Which pair of compounds are successive members of the same homologous series?

options.text: CH₃CH₂CHO and CH₃COCH₂CH₃
CH₃COOH and CH₃CH₂COOH
CH₃CH₂CH₂Cl and CH₃CHClCH₃
CH₃CH₂CH₂CH₃ and CH₃CH=CHCH₃

questions.explanation: Ethanoic acid and propanoic acid are both carboxylic acids (same functional group, general formula CₙH₂ₙO₂) and their formulas differ by one CH₂ unit, so they are successive members of one series.

questions.stem: The skeletal formula of a compound is a zig-zag line of five straight segments joined end to end. An –OH group is drawn at the point where the first and second segments meet (the second point from the left-hand end). No other atoms are shown. What is the molecular formula of the compound?

options.text: C₅H₁₂O
C₆H₁₄O
C₄H₁₀O
C₆H₁₅O

questions.stem: Which statement gives the defining feature of an unsaturated organic compound?

options.text: Its molecules contain at least one carbon–carbon double or triple bond.
Its molecules have fewer H atoms than the alkane with the same number of C atoms.
Some of the carbon atoms in its molecules have formed fewer than four bonds.
Its molecules contain a functional group, such as –OH or –Cl, in place of an H atom.

questions.explanation: An unsaturated compound contains at least one C=C or C≡C bond. A saturated compound contains only single bonds between its carbon atoms.

questions.stem: Methanol, ethanol, propan-1-ol and butan-1-ol are successive members of the homologous series of alcohols. Which statement about these four compounds is correct?

options.text: They fit one general formula and have similar chemical properties.
They share a functional group, so they have the same boiling point.
They are structural isomers of each other, as each has one –OH group.
Their chemical reactions differ widely, as their chain lengths differ.

questions.explanation: All four fit CₙH₂ₙ₊₁OH and contain the same functional group, the hydroxyl group, so they undergo similar reactions. Their physical properties change gradually along the series.
